name: Panhala Fort → Vishalgad (Pawankhind range trek)
tagline: Kolhapur's history trail — retracing Shivaji Maharaj's 1660 escape route
trailhead: Panhala (day visit) or full range trek start
seoTitle: Panhala to Vishalgad Trek Solo Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Panhala Fort and the Panhala-Pawankhind-Vishalgad range trek near Kolhapur — Maharashtra's southern trek cluster.
dataNote: This is Maharashtra's main trekking cluster outside the Pune/Mumbai/Nashik belt — logistics and support infrastructure differ, so treat this entry as two options: an easy Panhala-only day visit, and a much more committing multi-day range trek.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — green hills, the annual commemorative trek season

seasons.label: Mar – May
seasons.sub: Hot for the full range trek

routeOptions.name: Panhala Fort only
routeOptions.notes: A well-preserved, low-effort fort visit near Kolhapur — good standalone outing.

routeOptions.name: Full Panhala–Pawankhind–Vishalgad range trek
routeOptions.duration: Multi-day (often run as an annual commemorative trek)
routeOptions.notes: Commemorates Shivaji Maharaj's 1660 escape from Panhala and Baji Prabhu Deshpande's last stand at Pawankhind. A genuinely multi-day commitment — plan camping/village stays.

safety.intro: Panhala itself is low-risk; the full range trek to Vishalgad is a different proposition entirely and needs multi-day planning.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Decide upfront whether you're doing the easy Panhala visit or the full multi-day range trek — they have very different requirements
For the full range trek, arrange village stays/camping and water resupply points in advance

cards.title: On the trail
items: This region has less trekking-tourism infrastructure than Pune/Mumbai — carry more self-sufficiency buffer
Confirm trail markings with local trekking groups before a solo multi-day attempt

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: The full range trek is much more remote than Sahyadri treks near Pune/Mumbai — consider joining an organized group, especially for a first attempt

items.name: Rain gear for monsoon range trek
